description: Armenia - Solar Radiation Measurement Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Solar", published or maintained by Clara Ivanescu (World Bank Group). Data repository for solar measurements from 4 WB funded stations in Armenia. The four solar measuring stations and the associated measurement campaign have been financed by the Scaling-Up Renewable Energy Program (SREP) as part of the preparation activities for the Armenia Utility-Scale Solar Project. Coverage: Armenia. It has 9 files in CSV, XLS, ZIP. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Solar. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
